head: claude/mi124-never-firing-legs-diagnosis
title: MI-124: diagnose all ten never-firing sunset candidates - the packet's basis is false for 5 of them
body:
Closes the diagnosis half of `WO-20260905-NEVER-FIRING-LEGS-NEED-A-REPAIR-DIAGNOSIS-NOT-A-RETIREMENT`, operator-funded on `DEC-20260904-DEMOTE-AND-TUNE-FLOW` (`agree_flow_and_fund_repair`).

**READ-AND-DIAGNOSE ONLY.** No leg is retired, disabled or shadowed. `config/strategies.yaml`, `config/accounts.yaml`, `config/risk_caps.yaml` and `src/runtime/orders.py` are untouched. Every remedy is a proposal.

## Headline

**The sunset packet's stated basis is FALSE for 5 of the 10 candidates.** The packet says of each: *"has never closed a single trade in its life."* Five had closed trades in `trade_journal.db::trades` **before** the packet was generated.

Fully traced to `scripts/ops/sunset_pass.py:288`:

```python
life = lifetime.get(name, 0 if lifetime_state == "read" else None)
```

defended by a comment asserting that `/api/bot/performance` *"lists every strategy with any closed trade"*. It does not - `performance.py:324-326` filters `AND t.pnl IS NOT NULL`. So a leg whose every close carries `pnl NULL` is absent from the capture, defaults to `0`, and is filed `retire_candidate`. Measured: **52 enabled legs, 46 in the capture, 11 absent and silently defaulted to 0.**

**Not one of the ten was silent.** Eight of ten emitted actionable signals lifetime; `mes_trend_long_1d` emitted 686 buys, 2.5x the `iwm` control that did trade.

## Per-leg causes (closed vocabulary)

| leg | cause |
|---|---|
| `gdx` / `gld` / `iaum_pullback_1d` | `broken` - pnl accounting (premise false) |
| `scha` / `spy_trend_long_1d` | `broken` - pnl accounting (premise false) |
| `mes_trend_long_1d` | `broken` - exit/lifecycle (7/8 pkgs orphaned; trade 4350 open 33 days) |
| `splg_trend_long_1d` | `broken` - candle starvation (needs 46 candles, gets 15) |
| `tqqq_trend_long_1d` | **`not_established`** |
| `trend_donchian_sol` | `starved` by `trend_donchian_sol_4h` (same symbol + account) |
| `turtle_soup` | `mis_routed` (and `execution: shadow`, which the packet omits) |

`not_established`: **1 of 10** - below the contract's "more than half" review trigger.

## Method

Every negative has a denominator. Controls were chosen *inside the same families*: `iwm`/`qqq`/`qld_trend_long_1d`, and `trend_donchian_sol_4h` on the **same symbol and account** as its silent sibling. One control result changed the method - over a 4-day window the trading controls look identical to the candidates, so all counts are taken **lifetime**. Every `db/table` count asserted `filter_state: "applied"` before being trusted.

The conclusive control: `iwm_trend_long_1d` (which the packet passed) has 7 closes - 4 with real pnl, 3 with `pnl=None`, all via the same `exchange_flat_reconciled` path. A NULL pnl is not intrinsic to that path; the five falsified legs differ from `iwm` only in luck.

## On the predecessor's lead

Re-measured independently; its `6 / 2 / 1 / 1` **substantially holds**, with one correction: falsified premises are **5, not 6**. `trend_donchian_sol`'s only close is dated 2026-09-04, *after* the 09-01 packet - the packet was correct about that leg when written.

## Filed

- `BL-20260905-SUNSET-PASS-DEFAULTS-AN-ABSENT-LEG-TO-ZERO-CLOSES-AND-CALLS-IT-NEVER-TRADED` (high)
- `BL-20260905-SUNSET-PASS-GRADES-SHADOW-LEGS-ON-A-LIVE-TRADE-CRITERION` (medium)

Deliberately not filed - each restates an existing open row: the pnl-NULL class (`BL-20260807`, `BL-20260825`) and trade 4350 (`BL-20260820`).

## Guards

`python3 scripts/ci/run_guards.py --base main` -> **PASS 51 / FAIL 0 / SKIP 36**.

Two guards initially failed and both were mine, both correct catches (a truncated backlog id - the very class of `BL-20260904-CLAUDE-MD-CITES-A-TRUNCATED-BACKLOG-ID`; and a percentage with no stated population). Two others reported failing only because `pytest` was absent from the container; after installing it, `test_operator_owed` / `test_over_cover_decision` / `test_orderflow_capture_freshness` pass 78/78.

Full evidence: `docs/claude/diagnoses/MI-124-never-firing-legs-diagnosis.md`

Tier-1, landing self-declared in `.github/pr-landing/mi124-never-firing-legs-diagnosis.json`.
